t: DEWALT DW088CG-XJ self-levelling cross-line laser level provides rapid and precise level references for professional construction and installation tasks. The robust laser tool projects bright green horizontal and vertical lines, usable independently or as a cross, ideal for electricians installing trunking or kitchen fitters aligning cabinets. A self-levelling range of ±4° and accuracy of ±0.3mm/m ensure reliable results. Designed for durability, the unit withstands a 1m drop and carries an IP54 rating for indoor and outdoor work. Can be used in short or mid-range applications. Features include an integrated magnetic pivoting base with a 1/4" thread for use with a tripod, and built-in magnets for flexible mounting. Supplied with a heavy duty carry case for transport.
b: Heavy Duty Carry Case & Bracket Included
